basic_info.description: Enter a gracious foyer with a convenient coat closet, then ascend the stairs & be awestruck by abundant natural light from 8 skylights. The great room features a kitchen with generous counter space, a brand-new stove & refrigerator, a breakfast bar, & ample cabinetry flowing into the dining area. Walk down the sunlit hall to find a full  bathroom & a cozy bedroom on the right. On the left, the primary suite features an enormous walk-in closet & a spa-like bathroom with dual sinks, a spacious walk-in shower, & extensive cabinetry. At the end of the hall, the door opens to a sunny patio & garden with southern & western exposure ideal for gardening or afternoon lounging. The pice de rsistance is the hot tub, a wonderful way to unwind. Downstairs are a laundry closet, two bonus rooms, & a one-car garage. A fully permitted 2016 renovation added skylights, updated electrical, a new master bath, a renovated kitchen, enhanced insulation, & new windows. Located one block from McLaren Park San Francisco's 3rd largest, at 313 acres, featuring miles of trails, McNab Lake, playgrounds, community gardens, and the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater. This home also boasts a Transit Score of 63 - Good Transit - with many nearby public transport options for easy access to Downtown & the Peninsula.
